context:
Three patterns to apply:
1. Enumeration loop: FIELDS = [("src_attr", "dst_attr"), ...]; for s, d in FIELDS: setattr(dst, d, getattr(src, s))
2. Conditional accumulation: CONDITIONS = [(predicate_fn, value), ...]; result = [v for fn, v in CONDITIONS if fn()]
3. Optional dict builder: KEYS = [("src", "dst"), ...]; return {d: src[s] for s, d in KEYS if s in src}

Do not add abstraction layers beyond what's needed - a simple list + comprehension is sufficient.
Keep field definitions close to the function (module-level constant or near the function).
description:
10 functions have high complexity caused by 10-20 nearly-identical conditional blocks
that check a field, apply a transformation, and assign to a target. These are pure
mechanical repetition - not real branching logic - and should be collapsed into either
a loop over a field-definition list or a helper that handles the pattern once.

Target functions and pattern:
  benchbox/core/dataframe/tuning/interface.py:get_enabled_settings    (20) - check condition → add enum
  benchbox/core/runner/runner.py:_enrich_driver_runtime_metadata       (20) - extract adapter field → assign to result
  benchbox/core/results/schema.py:_build_execution_from_context        (18) - extract context field → dict entry
  benchbox/core/results/schema.py:_build_config_block                  (17) - extract with fallback → dict entry
  benchbox/core/schemas.py:populate_driver_metadata                    (17) - options.get() → assign if not set
  benchbox/core/schemas.py:to_cli_args                                 (16) - non-default field → append arg string
  benchbox/core/manifest/io.py:_manifest_v2_to_dict                    (18) - optional field present → add to dict
  benchbox/core/tuning/interface.py:get_enabled_tuning_types           (16) - check config attr → add to set
  benchbox/core/dryrun.py:_extract_df_tuning                           (16) - hasattr + is_default → build dict
  benchbox/cli/dryrun.py:generate_cli_command                          (16) - non-default flag → append to parts list

Each requires a field-definition approach: declare a list/dict of (source_field,
condition, transform, target_field) tuples, iterate once.

anti_patterns.dont: change the output type or structure of any function (callers depend on these)

anti_patterns.why: a list + loop is sufficient and more readable

anti_patterns.dont: merge the field definitions across functions
anti_patterns.why: each function gets its own field list

preserves.behavior: _build_execution_from_context: result dict must have identical keys/values for all inputs
_enrich_driver_runtime_metadata: all metadata fields must be populated identically
generate_cli_command: generated command must be copy-pasteable and functionally identical
get_enabled_settings: output set must contain exactly the same TuningType values as before
to_cli_args: CLI arg string output must be identical for all benchmark configurations

verifications.expected: No WARN entries for the 10 target functions
